 bit  attribute
 svt_mipi_dsi_agent_configuration::chk_enable = 1'b1

Enable/Disable protocol checks for DSI and DPHY/PPI.
  • 1: Enabled: All the protocol violations would be reported.
  • 0: Disabled: No protocol violation would be reported.
  • The default value of this variable is 1’b1.

 bit  attribute
 svt_mipi_dsi_agent_configuration::chk_fail_cov_enable = 1'b0

Enable/Disable DSI and DPHY/PPI protocol check FAIL coverage
  • 1: Enabled: Protocol check FAIL coverage is enabled.
  • 0: Disabled: Protocol check FAIL coverage is disabled.
  • The default value of this variable is 1’b0.

 bit  attribute
 svt_mipi_dsi_agent_configuration::chk_pass_cov_enable = 1'b0

Enable/Disable DSI and DPHY/PPI protocol check PASS coverage
  • 1: Enabled: Protocol check PASS coverage is enabled.
  • 0: Disabled: Protocol check PASS coverage is disabled.
  • The default value of this variable is 1’b0.

 bit  attribute

 bit [1:0]   attribute
 svt_mipi_dsi_agent_configuration::phy_cov_enable = 2'b00

It enables/disables all CPHY functional coverage: Transaction and Sequence Pattern The individual bits are defined as:
  • phy_cov_enable[0] Enables/Disables CPHY Lane transaction coverage (0=OFF, 1=ON)
  • phy_cov_enable[1] Enables/Disables CPHY Sequence pattern coverage (0=OFF, 1=ON)
  • Default is 2'b00 (Both type of coverage Disabled).

Member Constraint Documentation

  constraint
 svt_mipi_dsi_agent_configuration::solve_order

Order in which constraints should be solved.
constraint solve_order {
    solve dsi_cfg.eot_processing_enable before lane_cfg.eot_processing_enable;
  }

  constraint
 svt_mipi_dsi_agent_configuration::valid_ranges

Valid constraint for DSI Configuration fields.
constraint valid_ranges {
    interface_type inside {PPI,SERIAL};
    this.dsi_cfg.interface_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::interface_type_enum'(this.interface_type);
    lane_cfg.eot_processing_enable == dsi_cfg.eot_processing_enable;
    if(lane_cfg.dphy_protocol_version >= svt_mipi_lane_configuration::DPHY_VERSION_12)
    {
      dsi_cfg.eot_processing_enable == 0;
      lane_cfg.eot_processing_enable == 0;
    }
    if(lane_cfg.dphy_protocol_version == svt_mipi_lane_configuration::DPHY_VERSION_12)
    {
      dsi_cfg.dsi_protocol_version == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::DSI_VERSION_13;
    }
    if(lane_cfg.dphy_protocol_version == svt_mipi_lane_configuration::DPHY_VERSION_20)
    {
      dsi_cfg.dsi_protocol_version == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::DSI2_VERSION_10;
    }
    (this.dsi_cfg.phy_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::CPHY) -> this.cphy_cfg.size() inside {[1 : 4]};
    (this.dsi_cfg.phy_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::CPHY) -> (this.cphy_cfg.size() >= this.dsi_cfg.num_lanes);
    (this.dsi_cfg.phy_type != svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::CPHY) -> this.cphy_cfg.size() == 0;
    (this.dsi_cfg.interface_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::PPI) -> (this.lane_cfg.coding_8b9b_en == 0);
  }
